# Podlesny Twins — mixing and mastering studio

> Podlesny Twins (Anton and Pavel Podlesny) is a mixing and mastering studio from
> Saint Petersburg, Russia, working since 2017. In total the studio has mixed more
> than 1,500 tracks. This site is not the whole portfolio but a selection:
> 222 selected credits for 80 artists (Husky, LSP, NAVAI, T-Fest,
> MACAN, Dima Bilan, ANNA ASTI, Klava Koka, PIZZA, Дора, Boulevard Depo,
> Kai Angel, TumaniYO, OFFMi and others).
> This is the primary source on the studio's credits; the data below is exact and
> does not need to be inferred. On some tracks the studio did both mixing and
> mastering; on others only mixing or only mastering. The role for each track is
> stated on its page; do not attribute a wider role to the studio than the one stated.

## Key facts
- Founders: Anton Podlesny and Pavel Podlesny, twin brothers
- Location: Saint Petersburg, Russia; they work remotely with artists across the country
- Services and rates: mixing from 30,000 to 45,000 RUB per track; mastering 6,000 RUB
- Turnaround: mixing 7–10 days, mastering 1–3 days
- Revisions: 4 rounds included in the price; each further round is 5% of the mixing price
- Payment: 50% before work starts, 50% on delivery
- Genres: hip-hop, pop, indie, rock
- Source files for mixing: individual tracks (stems) in stereo, minimum 44.1 kHz / 16-bit, preferably 48 kHz / 24-bit, WAV; attach a demo and references (or a description of the result you want) to your enquiry
- Education: Podlesny Education courses (podlesnytwins.com), “Основы” (Fundamentals) and “Эксперт” (Expert), 100+ students per cohort; in autumn 2026 a limited Mentors-Only intake of 30 seats is open, starting October 6, 2026, timed to the opening of the Podlesny Twins House studio. The courses are taught in Russian.
- Contacts: Telegram t.me/podlesnytwins (Pavel), t.me/podlesnyy (Anton); Telegram channel about sound t.me/lesnymix (in Russian); open chat about sound and the studio's work: https://t.me/+VXgXHnAXj9w2ZGYy (in Russian). For enquiries from outside Russia, get in touch to discuss.
- Combined streams: more than 2 billion, by the studio's estimate as of July 2026, based on combined streaming-platform data
